name: empty
title: Empty
description: Nothing here, said plainly: a count cell, the message and the way out, in one frame or as a cell. Empty, error and first-use kinds.
whenToUse: Use it where a list or view has nothing to show, to say why and offer the way out. For a temporary loading state use Skeleton.

parts.name: Empty
parts.description: A place with nothing in it, said plainly: One frame of three cells: the count (the Count voice: how many there are, which is the fact), the message, and the way out. Below 520px of its own width the actions drop to a row of cells under the message, and the count cell shrinks to a band. No illustration: the number is the picture.

props.name: actions
props.description: Recovery or first actions: Buttons. The first is the way out (clear filters, retry, create).

props.name: code
props.description: The Code word under the figure. Defaults to RESULTS, ERROR or NEW.

props.name: count
props.description: The figure in the count cell. Defaults to 0 for empty, "!" for error; start shows a glyph.

props.name: kind
props.description: empty: a query or filter matched nothing (the count is 0) · error: the content could not be loaded (red count cell) · start: nothing has been made yet (first use; the count cell shows a + key line).

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own 2px region frame. cell: a cell of an enclosing frame (a panel body, a table).

props.name: live
props.description: Announce when it appears (status; alert for error). Use when it replaces content the user was looking at.
